description: During the 2026-05-14 morning vision walk, the operator wanted to defer decisions. Investigation showed the operational CLI exists and works: `prompt-manager team decision-defer <team-id> <decision-id> --revisit-after=YYYY-MM-DD [--notes=...]`. The social-media-scheduler decision was deferred to 2026-05-17 and Tier 1 pricing to 2026-06-25. Root issue is discoverability and documentation drift, not missing API/storage support. Problems observed: (1) `prompt-manager team decision-defer --help` and even subcommand-level --help return the stale top-level team help text, so agents infer the command is missing; (2) `prompt-manager team` description omits decision-* and knowledge-* commands despite printUsage listing them; (3) `morning-vision-walk` skill documents decision-accept with `--selected` even for single-proposal decisions, but the CLI correctly rejects --selected for single-proposal accept; (4) `morning-vision-walk` still documents `knowledge-add --by=vision-walk`, but current CLI rejects --by and expects runtime attribution plus `--caller-note`; (5) parity coverage for PATCH/PUT decisions says decision-update/accept/reject but omits decision-defer even though action resolver knows `decision-defer`. Expected fix: make nested team command help discoverable or at least update top-level descriptions/help; update morning-vision-walk command examples for accept/defer/knowledge-add; update parity coverage to name decision-defer; add focused CLI/help tests so future drift is caught. Acceptance: an agent can discover deferral via help or docs, `decision-defer` usage is correct in the vision-walk skill, and parity/help tests pass.
name: prompt-manager-decision-deferral-discoverability
title: Fix prompt-manager decision deferral discoverability and walk skill command drift
